[Girl]

I feel so good today~
I'm in the mood to go
on a picnic somewhere~
La la la la~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
啦啦啦~
今天心情真好~
真想去哪里野餐啊~
啦啦啦~

scripts.text: About Luoyang.
scripts.translation: 关于洛阳。

scripts.text: Go to Luoyang.
scripts.translation: 前往洛阳。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Oh, are you
interested in Luoyang?
It's a nice place to
visit for travelers.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哦，你对洛阳感兴趣吗？
那是个很适合旅行者游览的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Luoyang has a long history
with stories of ancient magic and warriors. It's also rumored that many evil beasts roam the
Luoyang area.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
洛阳历史悠久，流传着许多关于远古魔法和武者的传说。据说洛阳地区还出没着许多邪恶的魔兽。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
You can find cure-all medicines, mysterious occurrences, and
martial artists all in one place!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
在这里，你可以找到万能药、神秘事件，还有武术家！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I used to train in the martial arts every morning back when I was in Luoyang. I might not look like it, but I'm pretty strong!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我在洛阳的时候，每天早上都练习武术。别看我这样，我可是很强的哦！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
If you want to visit
Luoyang, feel free to
tell me. Just give me
some Zeny and we'll go~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
如果你想去洛阳，随时告诉我。只要给我一些泽尼，我们就出发~

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I'll guide you to
Luoyang right away.
For my service, I am
accepting 10,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我这就带你去洛阳。
作为服务费，我需要收取10,000泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
So, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
那么，准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 是的！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Okay~
Ready!
Have fun!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
好的~
准备！
玩得开心！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
...
You don't seem
to have 10,000 Zeny...
Go get some money first!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
……
你好像没有10,000泽尼……
先去赚点钱吧！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Oh...
It's so disappointing
to hear you say that.
Well, have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哦……
听到你这么说真让人失望。
好吧，祝你愉快！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Oh...
Have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哦……
祝你愉快！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Would you
like to go back
to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你想回艾尔贝塔吗？

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I hope to
see you again!
Bye bye!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
希望再次见到你！
拜拜！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
If you like this
area, why don't you
stay and enjoy the
the food and the sights!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
如果你喜欢这里，
不妨留下来享受
美食和美景吧！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
And by sights...
I mean girls!
Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
说到美景……
我指的是女孩子哦！
嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Girl]
And the boys here
aren't bad looking~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
这里的男孩子
长得也不错呢~

scripts.text:
[Zhi Ching Li]
All the members of the Maiden Palace, including myself and our master, are all female.
scripts.translation:
[支青丽]
少女宫的所有成员，包括我和师父，都是女性。

scripts.text:
[Zhi Ching Li]
Recently we've had a hard time recruiting new members, so I came here to check if there's any woman who wishes to join us.
scripts.translation:
[支青丽]
最近我们招募新成员很困难，所以我来这里看看有没有愿意加入我们的女性。

scripts.text:
[Zhi Ching Li]
...
scripts.translation:
[支青丽]
……

scripts.text:
[Zhi Ching Li]
...
......

[Zhi Ching Li]
Please leave me
alone, I'm busy.
scripts.translation:
[支青丽]
请别打扰我，
我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Akiira]
I am practicing my 'Claw of Dragon.' I not only need to use the power of my fists, I must also condition myself spiritually.
scripts.translation:
[阿基拉]
我正在练习“龙爪”。我不仅需要使用拳头的力量，还需要在精神上进行修炼。

scripts.text:
[Akiira]
Every martial art requires
spiritual training since the
mind controls the body.
If you've trained yourself spiritually, you can easily
use any part of the body!
scripts.translation:
[阿基拉]
因为心控制着身体，所以每种武术都需要精神训练。
如果你在精神上得到了锻炼，就能轻松地运用身体的任何部位！

scripts.text:
[Akiira]
If you are considering
studying the martial arts, you should first attain knowledge before jumping into the
physical training.
scripts.translation:
[阿基拉]
如果你考虑学习武术，在开始体能训练之前，应该先获取相关知识。

scripts.text:
[Akiira]
Learn about the martial arts
and meditate on life's truths. First, you must find peace of mind before you can hope to master the mind and body.
scripts.translation:
[阿基拉]
了解武术并冥想人生的真谛。首先，你必须找到内心的平静，然后才能希望掌握身心。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
Finally...
I have mastered
the 'Claw of Dragon!'
scripts.translation:
[张晓吉]
终于……
我掌握了“龙爪”！

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
Although there are eight basic steps, I had to learn the history of this art, and meditate, focusing on my spiritual improvement,
for three years.
scripts.translation:
[张晓吉]
虽然有八个基本步骤，但我不得不学习这门武术的历史，并通过冥想来专注于精神提升，这花了我三年时间。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
After that, my master finally started to give me the physical training so I could use the eight steps of the Claw of Dragon. I've devoted myself to this art for thirty years.
scripts.translation:
[张晓吉]
在那之后，师父终于开始对我进行体能训练，以便我能使用龙爪的八个步骤。我在这门武术上投入了三十年的心血。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
I'm very proud that I've
mastered this art ten years earlier than I expected. Now, I need to study this form and improve it by correcting its weak points and enhancing its strengths.
scripts.translation:
[张晓吉]
我很自豪能比预期提前十年掌握这门技艺。现在，我需要研究这一招式，通过纠正弱点和增强优点来改进它。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
I guess that would take me about ten years. But I'm not disheartened by that at all.
scripts.translation:
[张晓吉]
我想这大概需要我十年时间。但我对此并不感到气馁。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
When you're learning a martial art, you can't rush yourself and learn everything in a short period of time. It's impossible! Plus, that isn't the essence of art...
scripts.translation:
[张晓吉]
学习武术时，不能急于求成，想在短时间内学会一切是不可能的！而且，那也不是武术的精髓……

[Hong Miao]
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
欢迎光临。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
This is an elevator which leads
to the Observation Tower. We are providing you a safe and fast transfer service for an affordable fee. Would you like to use this service?
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
这是通往中央塔的电梯。我们以实惠的价格为您提供安全快速的转移服务。您想使用这项服务吗？

scripts.text: Information.
scripts.translation: 资讯。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
After many suggestions and proposals were sent to the Luoyang tourism office, the Observation Tower was built so tourists can enjoy the sights.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
在向洛阳旅游局提交了许多建议和提案后，中央塔得以建成，让游客可以欣赏美景。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
Due to the geographical
features of Luoyang, it's difficult to enjoy the breath taking view that our land has to offer.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
由于洛阳的地理特征，很难欣赏到这片土地令人叹为观止的景色。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
You can come up to the tower by taking the elevator right here. We are providing this quick and safe transfer service for 500 zeny per person.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
您可以乘坐这里的电梯登上塔顶。我们为每人提供快速安全的转移服务，费用为500泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
I'm sorry, but you do not have enough zeny. I hope you'll come back later to enjoy the Observation Tower. Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足。希望您稍后再来享受中央塔的美景。祝您愉快。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
Thank you for your patronage.
We are trying to provide you with the best of service. Please
come again.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
感谢您的惠顾。
我们致力于为您提供最好的服务。
欢迎再次光临。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
Please come
back later.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
请稍后再来。
祝您愉快。
